Entry.EnglishText: <Couleur>

Entry.JapaneseText: <Mel>
Entry.EnglishText: <Mel>

Entry.JapaneseText: <Rondoline>
Entry.EnglishText: <Rondoline>

Entry.JapaneseText: アルベルト
Entry.EnglishText: Albert

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>
Entry.EnglishText: <Suzu>

Entry.JapaneseText: オレらが牢屋に捕まってる間、 のんびり温泉つかりやがって！
Entry.EnglishText: So while *we* were locked up in the dungeon, *you* were living it up in the hotspring!?

Entry.JapaneseText: クルルルルゥ～？
Entry.EnglishText: Coululululuu~?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Couleur>に怒っても仕方ないよ
Entry.EnglishText: Getting mad at <Couleur> won't change anything.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうそう。 いい湯加減で気持ちよかったよね？
Entry.EnglishText: Right? And the water was perfect, too. It felt so good.

Entry.JapaneseText: クールール～ン♪
Entry.EnglishText: Cueuleureun~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: ロ、<Rody>まで オレらをほうって……？
Entry.EnglishText: S-So even *you* ditched us for the hotsprings, <Rody>...?

Entry.JapaneseText: だって、あの時は君たちが 捕まってるなんて知らなかったし
Entry.EnglishText: I mean, I didn't know you had been captured at the time, so.

Entry.JapaneseText: おらも温泉入りてぇだーよ。 ふくろだぬきが入ったなんて許せないだ
Entry.EnglishText: I want to try these onsen, too. Can't believe the dumb tanuki got to try' em, and I didn't...

Entry.JapaneseText: うちのお湯は酸性なので、 金具が錆びてしまうかもしれません
Entry.EnglishText: The water here is quite acidic, so it may corrode metallic objects.

Entry.JapaneseText: それに湿気で腐っちゃうかもだしね
Entry.EnglishText: And all the warm water'll probably make you rot, so.

Entry.JapaneseText: やんだやんだぁ。おらも<Mel><Mel>と<Rody>たんと ミーたまと<Suzu>ちんと一緒に温泉入りてぇだ～よ
Entry.EnglishText: I don't care. I want to take a nice warm dip with <Mel><Mel>, and <Rody>, and Miss <Mint>y, and Li'l <Suzu>...

Entry.JapaneseText: だったら、腐ったまま、 二度と湯からあがってくんな！
Entry.EnglishText: Then go and rot in there. Any luck, and we'll never have to see you again!

Entry.JapaneseText: そういう<Dio>こそ、 入らないの？
Entry.EnglishText: You don't want to try the hotspring yourself, <Dio>?

Entry.JapaneseText: え？ オレは……遠慮しとく。 あはは……
Entry.EnglishText: Eh? Nah, I'll, uh...just sit this one out. Ahaha...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>…… お風呂が嫌いなんです……
Entry.EnglishText: <Dio>... You really do hate baths, don't you...
